items.title: 1 Consumer Stock to Research Further and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. But they’re also double-edged swords as they often lag in booming conditions, and this pattern has persisted recently. Over the past six months, the industry has recorded a loss of 5.4%, a far cry from the S&P 500’s 6.2% ascent.

items.title: Did Molson Coors' (TAP) Steady Dividend Signal a Deeper Capital Allocation Shift Toward Premium Brands?
items.summary: Earlier this month, Molson Coors Beverage’s Board declared a regular quarterly dividend of US$0.48 per share on its Class A and Class B common stock, payable on September 18, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 28, 2026. This dividend affirmation comes as some market observers argue the company’s shares look undervalued relative to its beverage peers, given its focus on premium and higher-margin categories.
